finalText: Build now exits 0. The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js:17` — `resolveConfig` referenced an undefined bare variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, throwing a `ReferenceError` that aborted the build after all the compile/dedupe noise. Fixed by reading `env.retries` with a fallback to a new `DEFAULTS.maxRetries` constant. The 3 warnings (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, a circular import) are non-fatal and still print, but the build finishes clean with 0 errors.
